REGULATION imposed under 20th Clause of Passenger Transport Services Authority Statute Number 01 of 2000 and 24(2)(1) (xii), (xiii) and 24(3) Clauses of Passenger Transportation Statute Number 04 of 1992.

I, Ediriweera Weerawardena, Minister of Road Development, Transportation, Power and Energy and Housing and ConstructionCentral Province, as per the powers vested on me under 20th Clause of Passenger Transport Services Authority StatuteNumber 01 of 2000 and 24(2) (1) (xii), (xiii) and clauses of Passenger Transportation Statute Number 04 of 1992, impose thefollowing regulation with effect from the date of publishing of this Gazette.

As per the recommendations made in the interim report issued on 25.10.2016 by the Department of Transport and LogisticsManagement, University of Moratuwa, who regulated the pilot project named "SAHASARA" which was initially implementedon two routes from 20.07.2016 to 19.10.2016 with the objective of introducing a new transportation system aimed at minimizingthe difficulties faced by the passengers due to unhealthy competition among the bus operators, the so called ‘‘SAHASARA’’Project is to be implemented on all routes where buses registered under Central Provincial Passenger Transport ServiceAuthority shall transport passengers.
EDIRIWEERA WEERAWARDENA,Minister of Central Provincial RoadDevelopment, Transport, Power and Energy andHousing and Construction.
At the Office of the Minister of Central Provincial RoadDevelopment, Transport, Power and Energy andHousing and Construction,Kandy.27th October, 2016.
